fact: The Estratégia Nacional para a Banda Larga (ENBL) was instituted on 7 March 2016 by Resolução n.º 18/2016, with targets set for 2018 of 70% of households and 90% of businesses with broadband of at least 2 Mbps; the text describes it in the past tense.
title: Estratégia para a Governação Digital de Cabo Verde
